newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bilfinger sees 1997 construction output up 3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bilfinger sees 1997 construction output up 3 pct.

text.p: German construction group Bilfinger + Berger AG said on Thursday that it expected its 1997 group construction output to rise by 3.0 percent after a jump of 13.9 percent in the first five months of the year.

The company said total output for the year was expected to be 9.52 billion marks ($5.4 billion). For the first five months it totalled 3.783 billion. Orders in hand at May 31 totalled 10.118 billion while incoming orders rose 2.1 percent to 3.922 billion.

"We are planning group construction output of 9.520 billion marks for 1997 with an overseas quota of 53 percent," management board chairman Christian Roth said according to the text of a speech to be delivered to the company's shareholder meeting.
He added that domestic output would ease by 7.1 percent to 4.518 billion marks in the year, while foreign output would rise by 14.2 percent to 5.003 billion marks.
